review_candidates.title: Server & Cloud Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The Azure / Microsoft 365 Systems Engineer is responsible for the design, administration, security, and ongoing support of the bank’s Microsoft cloud and hybrid infrastructure and plays a key role in ongoing cloud migration and modernization initiatives. Key Responsibilities Provide day-to-day administration, monitoring, configuration, permissions management, and service health oversight across Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, Power Platform, F
eligibility_evidence: The Azure / Microsoft 365 Systems Engineer is responsible for the design, administration, security, and ongoing support of the bank’s Microsoft cloud and hybrid infrastructure and plays a key role in ongoing cloud migration and modernization initiatives.

Design, deploy, maintain, patch, and update Azure and hybrid infrastructure supporting virtual machines, networking, storage, connectivity, identity synchronization, and related platform configuration changes.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Ensure systems meet internal security standards, regulatory requirements, and operational best practices; support audit and examination requests as needed.
